__comment: The cartographer's level-2 underground-cabin map. Until 26 this was built in Java by VillagerUndergroundCabinMapTrade, which 26 leaves nowhere to live: trades are registry entries now and neither loader kept a hook to add one. The exploration_map loot function performs the identical sequence (MapItem.create at zoom 2 / renderBiomePreviewMap / addTargetDecoration with a '+'), so this is the same offer, not an approximation. Dropped from the jar below 26 by DataPackMigration.dropVillagerTradeData.
